vacancy.title: Python Software Engineer (remote work)
vacancy.description:
TuxCare offers a comprehensive portfolio of security solutions for Linux and open-source software designed for enterprise organizations.
With TuxCare, companies can automate vulnerability patching, minimize downtime, maintain security and compliance, and rely on deep expertise in Linux and open-source security.
Our solutions cover widely used Linux distributions, end-of-life systems, open-source software ecosystems, and other critical infrastructure.
Learn more at: https://tuxcare.com/ / https://tuxcare.com/endless-lifecycle-support/
We're looking for a Software Engineer to join the ELS Delivery Pipeline team within our Endless Lifecycle Support (ELS) product. ELS provides security updates for software versions that are no longer maintained upstream. The delivery pipeline takes reported vulnerabilities through assessment, patching, building, testing, and package publication across supported ecosystems. Our team builds and operates the internal services, tools, and integrations that connect these stages and track work through to release. We automate repetitive tasks and help engineering teams diagnose and recover from pipeline failures.
For this role, it is critical that you have experience owning production systems end to end — from clarifying requirements directly with stakeholders to designing, implementing, deploying, and operating solutions. You will work across existing services and tools, improving reliability, simplifying workflows, and verifying results in production.

Key Responsibilities:
Build pipelines that publish security advisories from vulnerability assessments and released fixes.
Automate vulnerability assessment across large inventories of packages, versions, and dependencies across ecosystems.
Integrate vulnerability discovery scanners, reconcile their findings, and connect results to assessment and patching workflows.
Build and operate Python services, command-line tools, and internal interfaces for engineers assessing vulnerabilities, tracking patches, and managing releases.
Work directly with stakeholders to clarify requirements, agree priorities, and define how results will be verified.
Improve build and deployment automation, monitor production systems, and troubleshoot failures across services, containers, and data stores.
Review code and improve automated testing, security, and maintainability.
Use AI coding agents in day-to-day development, reviewing and testing the code they produce.
Must have
Experience building and maintaining production software in Python.
Strong Linux troubleshooting and production-debugging skills.
Experience designing and integrating APIs and services.
Experience with asynchronous or distributed processing.
Experience with CI/CD, containers, and build or deployment automation.
Solid relational data-modelling and SQL skills.
Advanced hands-on experience using coding agents for real engineering tasks, including delegating substantial work, providing context and constraints, supervising autonomous execution, and independently reviewing, debugging, testing, and validating agent-generated output.

Nice to have
Experience with Python stack: Django, Django REST Framework, Celery, and RabbitMQ.
Experience building services or command-line tools in Go.
Experience with package ecosystems, dependency metadata, or vulnerability data formats such as OSV.
What's in it for you?
Work independently with a high level of ownership and autonomy.
Fully remote work with flexible working hours.
24 paid vacation days, 10 national holidays, and unlimited sick leave.
Private medical insurance compensation.
Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement.
Education budget.
Opportunity to receive a reward for innovative ideas that the company can patent.

By applying for this position, you consent to the processing of your personal data as described in our Privacy Policy (https://tuxcare.com/privacy-policies-hub/candidate-privacy-notice/), which provides detailed information on how we maintain and handle your data.

vacancy.title: Middle Java Developer
vacancy.description:
EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 300 customers worldwide.

But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people. With a team of over 1400 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe and Asia, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork.

Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time.

We are looking for a dedicated Middle Java Developer to join our team in London!

About the job:
This is a rare opportunity to shape how data-driven decision-making works at scale across an iGaming CRM platform — both from the inside and for the operators who rely on it. s it is about analysis.

What You'll get to do:

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance microservice applications using Java 21+ and Spring Boot.

  • Design and implement scalable, resilient, and high-performance solutions.

  • Work with relational and OLAP databases, writing efficient SQL queries in PostgreSQL and ClickHouse.

  • Develop code to process complex data structures to / from Kafka.

  • Ensure best practices in microservice architectures, including API design, scalability and security.

  • Collaborate closely with other team members, including DevOps, Front End, Product and QA

  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions and continuous improvement initiatives.

What we’re looking for:

  • 3+ years of commercial experience in Java development.

  • Strong knowledge of Java 21+ and Spring Boot.

  • Good experience with developing on Linux and a familiarity with bash scripting.

  • Experience with SQL databases and writing optimised queries.

  • Experience with ClickHouse is a plus, but not required.

  • Experience with Kafka (experience with Avro is a plus but not required).

  • Experience with a wide range of enterprise Java and Spring components, including Spring Data JPA.

  • Experience with containerisation technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Experience with stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink is a plus but not required.

  • Familiarity with SSO mechanisms including OpenID is a plus but not required.

  • A basic understanding of core microservice components such as service discovery, API gateway and service monitoring.

  • Previous exposure to the gaming / sports betting industry is a plus but not required.

  • Solid understanding of microservice architectures and best practices.

  • Experience with AI code assistance tools such as Gemini and Claude, and a desire to work with an AI-first mindset.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work in an agile environment.

  • An ability to pay close attention to detail whilst also seeing the big picture.

  • More than anything, we are looking for candidates who are good communicators, curious and inquisitive, and who love solving problems both individually and as part of a team.

Here's what we offer:

  • Start with 25 days of annual leave, with 2 additional days added each year, up to 35 days by your fifth year with us. 

  • Hybrid work schedule is available after the first three months of employment, with up to 50 days of work from home per year.

  • Private medical insurance with the option to add dependants.

  • Monthly meal allowance. 

  • Gym allowance.

  • Access to online learning platforms like Udemy for Business and LinkedIn Learning, and a budget for external training. 

  • Benefit from two Free Fridays each year, limited to one per quarter.

  • 3 sick leave days per year, no doctor's note required.

  • Support for New Parents: 

 - 52 weeks of paid maternity leave, with 21 weeks being fully paid

  -  4 weeks of paternity leave, plus the flexibility to work from home full-time until your child is 13 weeks old. 

At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference! 

EveryMatrix is a member of the World Lottery Association (WLA) and European Lotteries Association. In September 2023 it became the first iGaming supplier to receive WLA Safer Gambling Certification. EveryMatrix is proud of its commitment to safer gambling and player protection whilst producing market leading gaming solutions.

vacancy.title: Senior Software Engineer
vacancy.description:
EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 300 customers worldwide.

But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people. With a team of over 1400 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe and Asia, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork.

Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time.


We are looking for a dedicated Senior Software Engineer to join our team in Armenia!

About the role:

We are looking for a senior generalist engineer. You will work across PHP, AngularJS, Go, Node, and SQL. Strong in PHP, able to pick up Go and Node as needed, able to work in a system you did not write.

You own features from design to production, write short design docs before non-trivial work, and work directly with product and QA. You already use agentic coding tools daily.
Senior here is not about years of experience. It is about how you operate, technically and with people:

  • Takes the hard tasks. Picks up the unclear, risky, or unpopular problem and drives it until it is working in production for real users. Done means live, not a ticket status.

  • Flexible in solutions. Has more than one way to solve a problem and chooses based on constraints, not habit.

  • Moves fast when it matters. Knows when to ship quickly and when to slow down, and can tell the difference.

  • Communicates. Explains decisions clearly, keeps people informed, raises problems early instead of late.

  • Gives and takes feedback. Direct, specific, constructive. Not defensive when the feedback comes back.

  • Owns outcomes. Not just the code, but whether the thing actually works for the people using it.


    What you'll get to do:

  • Build and ship features across the stack: data model, API, UI.

  • Help split the monolith into services: define service boundaries, plan data migrations, roll out changes step by step without downtime.

  • Modernize legacy code where it pays off.

  • Write short design docs for non-trivial changes.

  • Own what you ship: monitoring, alerts, fixes.

  • Design schemas, write efficient queries, build reports operators depend on.

  • Review code and mentor.

    What we're looking for:

  • Solid experience building and running production software at a senior level.

  • Strong in PHP; able to pick up Go and Node as needed.

  • Solid with relational databases: schema design, query performance, migrations on live data.

  • Experience improving a large legacy codebase incrementally.

  • Usage of agentic AI coding tools daily. You can show us how you plan work for an agent, where you trust it, and where you don't.

  • Writing tests and treating correctness especially seriously where money, commissions, and reporting are involved.

  • Writing clear design docs, tickets, and PR descriptions.

  • Communicating directly with product, QA, and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Working English, spoken and written.

    Nice to have

  • Splitting a monolith into services in production.

  • Kubernetes and Cloudflare in daily operations.

  • LLM-backed features: pipelines, evaluation, self-hosted open-weight models, MCP servers.

  • Applied ML in production (recommendation or scoring).

  • Payments, fintech, or iGaming.

  • Web scraping at scale, anti-bot handling, proxies.

Here's what we offer:

  • Start with 24 days of annual leave, with 2 additional days added each year, up to 34 days by your fifth year with us.

  • Benefit from two Free Fridays each year, limited to one per quarter.

  • Access online learning platforms like Udemy for Business and LinkedIn Learning, and a budget for external training.

  • Daily catered lunch or monthly lunch allowance.

  • Private Medical Subscription.

  • Gym allowance.

  • Parking

  • Team-building activities in various locations.
